scientific_integrity: A complete elementary proof is included; numerical checks are supplementary, and the classical mixed-area identity is credited as existing knowledge.
scientific_limitations: Only planar convex regular polygons and their relative-rotation excluded area; no adsorption saturation law or arbitrary convex-shape classification is asserted. Literature priority is subject to unindexed older computations.
title: An exact least-common-multiple law for rotational excluded areas of regular polygons
